rdw_enabled.description: Enable or disable the Radio Device Wizard globally.

rdw_devices.description: List of supported radio device types managed by RDW. Valid values: bluetooth, wifi, wwan.

rdw_batt_enabled_by_default.description: Radio devices to disable by default when on battery power. Empty list keeps them enabled.

rdw_ac_enabled_by_default.description: Radio devices to disable by default when on AC power. Empty list keeps them enabled.
